records.scope_note: No structural design allowable, certified grade, universal value or bound. Do not merge 28-day saturated state with 3-year air-dry/saturated experiments. Preserve unknown density basis (bulk/apparent/true terminology not stated by authors for this concrete value), test temperature, porosity and exact test subprocedure. Source 20 °C is curing/storage, not density-test temperature. The source reports demolding after 24 h followed by 28-day water storage while calling the selected testing age 28 days; retain its nominal 28-day designation without inferring 29 days. Density deviations within 20 kg/m³ of the mean are not an SD, confidence interval or uncertainty.
